Title: Generally Available: Azure Premium SSD v2 Disk is now available in US Gov Arizona

Body.Content:
Azure Premium SSD v2 is now available in US Gov Arizona (a region without Availability Zone).  

Azure Premium SSD v2 disk, a next-generation general-purpose block storage option for Azure virtual machines, offers sub-millisecond latencies and exceptional price performance for IO-intensive workloads at a low cost. Premium SSD v2 is suited for a broad range of enterprise production scenarios, including SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SAP, Cassandra, MongoDB, big data/analytics, and gaming on virtual machines or stateful containers. 

If Premium SSD v2 is unavailable in your preferred region and you would like to use it, please complete this survey.    

Learn more:    

  • Read the documentation.  
  • Premium SSD v2 Disk Storage pricing
